_readme: Products sold by Instagram and Facebook sellers in Jordan.
Neither platform can be read automatically - both serve a login wall with no
post content - so these are added by hand. Everything here appears on the site
like any other product (categories, filters, search, comparison), and its Buy
button opens the original post in a new tab.
Add entries to the "listings" array below. Required fields:
platform  "instagram" or "facebook"
postUrl   link to the exact post, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/p/ABC123/
title     what the product is, written like a shop would write it,
e.g. "Gigabyte RTX 4060 Gaming OC 8GB Graphics Card"
price     number, in JOD, e.g. 289
Optional:
seller      the account, e.g. "@amman.gaming"
image       direct image URL, otherwise the card shows a placeholder
was         the old price, if it is on offer
category    a hint if the title is vague, e.g. "graphics card"
brand       e.g. "Gigabyte"
description free text
inStock     false if it has sold; defaults to true
Anything missing a valid postUrl, price or title is rejected at build time and
never reaches the site, so nothing invented can slip in.
The better the title, the better it is categorised and filtered - write the
brand, model and capacity the way a shop would.
